content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing an issue with [product_name] [version_no] on Windows 10 (64-bit). While programming, I encountered an error: "An unexpected error occurred. Your data may be inconsistent and further errors may happen. java.lang.NullPointerException". I saved the project and restarted the software, but then it kept trying to open the project in a loop and ended up corrupting it so it won't open anymore. Does anyone know how to solve this? Right now, [product_name] [version_no] is unusable to me.

[product_name] [version_no] officially supports Windows 7 and 8, not Windows 10. You can upgrade for free to the latest version, [product_name] [version_no]. You can find the download, release notes, and instructions at [url]. Install the upgrade with administrator privileges.

I encountered similar issues with older versions of [product_name]. The latest release appears stable so far. Most of my problems were related to copying and pasting in ladder logic—sometimes the pasted content would end up hidden, or deleting single contacts could cause errors like yours. In those cases, both the software and the saved file became corrupted, and I had to retype my program from scratch. I recommend using the most recent version and regularly saving backups with unique filenames to minimize the risk of losing work. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members describe reliability and compatibility issues with [product_name] [version_no] on Windows 10, including a java.lang.NullPointerException that leads to file corruption and makes projects inaccessible. There is also a mismatch between user expectations for Windows compatibility and the official support, alongside insufficient error recovery from file corruption.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] [version_no] to function reliably on Windows 10, without corrupting project data, and to recover gracefully from errors so that files remain usable.
